full_prompt_en: An impressionistic digital oil painting shows an old canal city beneath a full moon. The moon glows through broken clouds near the upper center, surrounded by a mottled sky of slate blue, cold turquoise, and deep ink-colored patches. Beneath it, a large domed building rises on the right bank, its cupola and pale stone façade picked out by scattered warm windows. Older blocky buildings sit along the left bank in deeper shadow, their few lamps flickering amber against the blue night. A low stone bridge crosses the canal from the left foreground toward the middle distance, and narrow streets open into a softly lit gap behind it. The canal occupies the lower third, carrying long, broken reflections of moonlight, windows, and lamps toward the viewer. The water surface is rendered with short horizontal streaks and irregular patches rather than a polished mirror, giving its light an unsettled shimmer. Architectural details are selective: the dome, bridge arch, and window rhythms remain legible while walls and edges dissolve into loose, granular paint. The brightest cool light remains in the sky and water; small golden lights punctuate the banks and make the quiet scene feel inhabited. Dark framing masses at either side guide the eye through the water to the domed silhouette. The whole frame settles into a hushed nocturne of textured blue, soft silver, and modest human warmth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅印象派气息的数字油画，呈现满月下的古老运河城。月亮在上方中央附近透过断续的云层发光，周围的天空由石板蓝、冷青色和深墨色斑块交织而成。其下，右岸一座大型穹顶建筑拔地而起，小圆顶与浅色石墙被零星的暖色窗光勾亮。左岸较老的方正建筑沉在更深的阴影里，少数灯光在蓝色夜幕前闪着琥珀色。一座低矮的石桥从左侧前景跨过运河，通向中景；桥后狭窄的街道在柔和灯光里敞开一道空隙。运河占据下方约三分之一，月色、窗光和路灯的细长倒影被水流打碎，向观者延伸。水面由短短的水平笔触与不规则色片绘成，并非光滑的镜面，因此亮色显得微微摇曳。建筑细节有选择地保留：穹顶、桥拱与窗子的节奏仍然清楚，墙面和边缘却融入松动、颗粒感的颜料。最明亮的冷光停留在天空和水中；小片金色灯光点缀两岸，使静谧的场景显得有人居住。两侧深色体量引导视线沿河水走向穹顶的剪影。整幅画安定为一首由粗粝蓝色、柔和银光和克制的人间暖意组成的夜曲。
style_prompt_en: The digital oil image has an impressionistic, granular surface in layered slate blue, turquoise, and near-black. Broad, softly broken masses occupy the upper field, while a band of small warm accents draws a measured rhythm through the middle. The lower area catches cool light in short horizontal streaks and irregular reflective patches. Edges stay selective: a few structural contours read clearly, then dissolve into scumbled paint and atmospheric shadow. A pale circular glow acts as the highest value, answered by fragmented silver-blue marks below. Amber pinpoints provide a restrained counterweight to the dominant cool palette. Darker side masses funnel attention inward, and the vertical movement from glowing upper space to shimmering lower space gives the composition its calm cadence. The whole frame feels quiet, spacious, and subtly inhabited through the balance of soft light and tactile brushwork.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅数字油画的表面带有印象派式的颗粒感，由层叠的石板蓝、青色和近黑色构成。上部是宽阔而柔软破碎的色块，中部一列细小暖色亮点形成克制的节奏。下方以短促的水平笔触和不规则反光色片捕捉冷光。边缘有选择地保留：少数结构轮廓清晰可辨，随后便融入擦涂的颜料和大气阴影。一处淡色圆形亮光成为最高明度，与下方破碎的银蓝色笔迹呼应。琥珀色光点为占主导的冷色盘提供克制的平衡。两侧更暗的体量将注意力引向画面内部，从上方发光空间到下方微微闪动区域的纵向移动，赋予构图平静的节拍。整幅画借由柔和光线与可触笔触的平衡，显得静谧、开阔，并隐约带着生活气息。
theme_en: Moonlight over an old canal city
name: Moonlit
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
